Meter to Foot Converter

Free online meter to foot converter that runs entirely in your browser.

How the Meter to Foot Converter works

The Meter to Foot Converter works on Value to convert, From unit, To unit and shows the result as you type. The same input always gives the same answer — refresh the page and you will see exactly the same figure.

Formula used

value in target unit = value in source unit × (source factor ÷ target factor)

Every unit is first converted to a common base, then to the target unit, so accuracy stays intact no matter which pair you pick. For temperature the conversion uses offsets rather than plain multiplication.

Inputs used: Value to convert, From unit, To unit.

Worked example

Converting 1 Meter into Foot:

  • 1 Meter = 3.28084 Foot

Frequently asked questions

How many Foot are in 1 Meter?
1 Meter equals 3.28084 Foot.
What is the conversion formula for Meter to Foot?
1 Meter = 3.2808399 Foot. The converter applies the same factor in reverse when you swap the two units.
Is the Meter to Foot Converter free?
Yes. There is no signup, no usage limit and no watermark — the converter runs entirely in your browser.
Does the Meter to Foot Converter store or send my data?
No. Every calculation happens locally in the page, so the numbers you type are never uploaded or logged.
Does it work on a phone and offline?
Yes — the page is a single lightweight file that adapts to any screen size. Once it has loaded it keeps working without a network connection.
